data.title: About Alexa
bio: Alexa brings the Green Light Realty approach — technology, local knowledge, and a relationships-first mindset — to clients throughout Central Jersey.
Whether you're buying your first home or selling to move up, Alexa walks you through pricing, neighborhoods, and next steps so nothing catches you off guard.
Reach out to Alexa for local market expertise and guidance from first conversation to closing day.
